extraction.notes: Summer 2027 programs and schedule are posted. First Camp, First Camp - Music Week, Gathering Expedition Camp, Soak & Soar Explorers and Soak & Soar Mountaineers appear only in the supplied 2026 brochure and are omitted. Individual program pages attempted through the browser returned no readable content; supplied fetched pages and the 2027 summer overview support the cards below. No registration opening date was found. The official registration page directs summer 2027 registrations to CampWise.

excluded.name: Grands Camp
excluded.reason: Family-only program attended by grandparents and grandchildren together.

excluded.name: Music Week
excluded.reason: Adult-only program for ages 18 and older.

excluded.name: bRIDGE Family Camp
excluded.reason: Family-only program; not listed in the current 2027 summer offerings.

cards.name: Day Camp
cards.description: Campers swim, practice archery and canoeing, climb, hike, play games and make crafts. Each week has a different theme; breakfast and lunch are included.

registration.text: Save $50 when you register by December 31, 2026.

financial_aid.text: If Tier I is still out of reach, there are scholarship funds for families in that spot.

lunch.text: Breakfast and lunch are included every day.

cards.name: PreKamp
cards.description: Children participate in songs, crafts, games, a water day and Bible stories.

cards.name: Pioneers
cards.description: Campers spend a full week at camp with a counselor living in their cabin and participate in classic camp activities.

cards.name: Pioneer Sampler
cards.description: A two-night introduction to overnight camp for younger campers.

cards.name: Climb High
cards.description: Campers climb the indoor wall and challenge tower and spend a day on a nearby high ropes course.

cards.name: Crazy Cool Campout
cards.description: Campers spend a night in tents, hike to a waterfall and cook dinner over a fire.

cards.name: Cave & Wave Explorers
cards.description: Campers visit Worley's Cave, spend a day whitewater rafting and camp out for a night.

cards.name: Night Owl Explorers
cards.description: Campers follow a later sleeping schedule and watch the sunset from Bearwallow.

cards.name: Bike & Hike Explorers
cards.description: Campers take mountain biking lessons, ride a trail in Dupont State Forest and hike in Pisgah.

cards.name: Kairos Confirmation Camp
cards.description: Confirmation programming includes a keynote speaker, Kairos musicians and small groups.

cards.name: River Explorers
cards.description: Campers tube the French Broad River and choose activities throughout the week.

cards.name: Wild Waters Explorers
cards.description: Campers take a canoe trip with an overnight beside the water and spend a day whitewater rafting.

cards.name: Parkway Peak Explorers
cards.description: Campers hike two summits near the Blue Ridge Parkway and camp overnight above 5,000 feet.

cards.name: Sky Explorers
cards.description: Campers spend a day on a high ropes course with bridges, cable walks and climbs up to 25 feet.

cards.name: Campfirmation
cards.description: Pastors teach confirmation through the seasons of the church year alongside camp activities.

cards.name: Parkway Peak Mountaineers
cards.description: Campers camp below Mount Mitchell and hike to its summit.

cards.name: Rock & Raft Mountaineers
cards.description: Campers climb and hike at Lutherock, camp out overnight and spend a full day whitewater rafting.

cards.name: Cave & Wave Mountaineers
cards.description: Campers visit Worley's Cave, raft whitewater and camp out for a night, with a focus on leadership.

cards.name: Night Owl Mountaineers
cards.description: A late-night camp week during the Fourth of July and Christmas in July themes that introduces campers to what being a counselor involves.

cards.name: Wild Waters Mountaineers
cards.description: Campers take a canoe expedition with an overnight beside the water and spend a day whitewater rafting.

cards.name: Road Trip: Charleston
cards.description: Campers travel to Charleston, stay on the Isle of Palms, participate in a service project and visit the beach.

cards.name: Summershine
cards.description: A full week of camp for teens and adults with developmental disabilities.

special_needs.text: A full week of camp for teens and adults with developmental disabilities.

cards.name: Appalachian Impact
cards.description: High school youth groups participate in service projects for communities rebuilding after Hurricane Helene and an adventure day.
cards.review_notes: The overview lists 13 sessions, but its week-by-week schedule does not distinguish all 13. Search results describe bases at both Lutheridge and Lutherock. Individual program pages returned no readable content; verify session dates, site assignments, drop-off locations and rates directly with the provider. The official service-week page says to email Pastor Drew Yoos at dyoos@novusway.org to reserve a group week.
